microzoospore.definition:
n. A small motile spore furnished with two vibratile
   cilia, found in certain green algae.

microzyme.definition:
n. A microorganism which is supposed to act like a ferment
   in causing or propagating certain infectious or contagious diseases; a
   pathogenic bacterial organism.
microzyme.translation:
n. 酵母菌
[医] 微胶粒, 分子团
